$description: Alpha design system tokens. Generated — edit packages/alpha-ds/src/tokens/*.ts.

bg-chrome.$description: Window chrome (top bar). The only surface outside the three tiers.

bg-inverse.$description: Inverted surface for the rare transient overlay (tooltip).

fg-3.$description: Text 3 — least important text; still AA on Background 1/2.

fg-on-accent.$description: Glyph on an accent-filled icon control (send).

line-2.$description: Border 2 — the default rule for boxes, cards, layout lines.

line-3.$description: Border 3 — rules on Background 3, where Border 2 would vanish.

line-strong.$description: Full-ink brutalist frame (outer window, primary outline).

accent-1.$description: Accent 1 — the one primary action. Icon/badge scale only.

accent-1-hover.$description: Accent 1 pressed/hover fill (flat step, spec: opacity drop).

accent-1-text.$description: Accent 1 when it must be read as text (links, labels).
